# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Compliance — Overview

> 5 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Compliance under Overview. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Activities](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/activities.md): List compliance activities for the authenticated tenant.
- [Apps](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps.md): Lists chat metadata with filtering capabilities for targeted compliance review. Results are sorted chronologically (time ascending) by the `order_by` key, with ties broken by id.
- [Code](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/code.md): List Claude Code Artifacts owned by organizations under the parent organization.
- [Groups](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/groups.md): Maximum results (default: 500, max: 1000)
- [Organizations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/organizations.md): Maximum results (default: 1000, max: 1000)
